paragraphs: Hi, I am Sam. I am eight years old. How old are you? This is my home. It is a small house. Mom, Dad, and I live here. We have a living room and a bathroom too. Come in, my friend! Put your shoes at the door, please.

This is the kitchen. It is next to the living room. Mom makes rice here. The kitchen has a big window. Look! A bee is on the window. It is yellow and black. Mom opens the window. The bee flies to the garden. It is happy now. "Bye, bee!" I say. Do you have a window in your kitchen?

This is my bedroom. It has a bed and a desk. A brown bear sits on my bed. He is a toy. He has a red hat and a big smile. I sleep next to him. I read a book to him at night. Do you have a toy bear? Where is your bed? Tell me about your home!
text.summary: Sam shows a visitor around his small house. He tells his name and age, and he shows the kitchen, a bee at the window, and a toy bear in his bedroom.
